name: Dr. Ayesha Raza
title: Senior Physiotherapist & Pelvic Health Specialist
photo_alt: Dr. Ayesha Raza, board-certified physiotherapist, in a Physionnisa clinic room in Lahore
bio: With over 12 years of clinical practice between Lahore and abroad, Dr. Ayesha Raza has built a holistic approach to pelvic health that integrates orthopedic physical therapy with specialized internal health strategies. Her mission at Physionnisa is to make pelvic floor and post-natal care openly discussed and accessible for women across Pakistan.
education: Doctor of Physical Therapy (DPT), University of Lahore, 2010–2014; MS in Pelvic Floor Rehabilitation, Riphah International University, Islamabad, 2015–2017
specializations: Pelvic Health, Post-Natal Recovery, Sports Injury Rehab
memberships: Pakistan Physical Therapy Association (PPTA), International Continence Society (ICS), Section on Women's Health (APTA)
clinic: Physionnisa Central Clinic, Gulberg III, Lahore

name: Dr. Sana Farooq
title: Sports Physiotherapist & Injury Rehabilitation Specialist
photo_alt: Dr. Sana Farooq, sports physiotherapist, reviewing a movement assessment in clinic
bio: Dr. Sana Farooq specializes in rehabilitating female athletes and active women, from university sports teams to weekend runners. She combines biomechanical assessment with sport-specific return-to-play programming to get patients back to full activity safely.
education: Doctor of Physical Therapy (DPT), University of Health Sciences Lahore, 2013–2017; Certificate in Sports Physiotherapy, Lahore College of Physical Therapy, 2018
specializations: Sports Injury Rehabilitation, ACL Prevention, Orthopedic Rehabilitation
memberships: Pakistan Physical Therapy Association (PPTA), Sports Physiotherapy Society of Pakistan
clinic: Physionnisa Central Clinic, Gulberg III, Lahore

name: Dr. Mahnoor Iqbal
title: Prenatal & Pregnancy Physiotherapy Specialist
photo_alt: Dr. Mahnoor Iqbal, prenatal physiotherapist, consulting with a pregnant patient
bio: Dr. Mahnoor Iqbal focuses exclusively on pregnancy-safe movement and pain management, working closely with patients' OB/GYNs to design trimester-adapted care plans that carry through to birth preparation.
education: Doctor of Physical Therapy (DPT), Riphah International University, Lahore, 2015–2019; Diploma in Women's Health Physiotherapy, 2020
specializations: Prenatal Physiotherapy, Pregnancy-Related Pain, Birth Preparation
memberships: Pakistan Physical Therapy Association (PPTA), Section on Women's Health (APTA)
clinic: Physionnisa Central Clinic, Gulberg III, Lahore

name: Dr. Hira Chaudhry
title: Orthopedic & Chronic Pain Rehabilitation Specialist
photo_alt: Dr. Hira Chaudhry, orthopedic physiotherapist, performing a manual therapy assessment
bio: Dr. Hira Chaudhry manages complex, long-standing musculoskeletal cases — from chronic back pain to post-surgical recovery — building multi-week rehabilitation plans in coordination with referring physicians.
education: Doctor of Physical Therapy (DPT), Superior University Lahore, 2011–2015; Certified Manual Therapist, Orthopedic Manual Therapy Institute, 2016
specializations: Chronic Pain Management, Orthopedic Rehabilitation, Post-Surgical Recovery
memberships: Pakistan Physical Therapy Association (PPTA), International Federation of Orthopaedic Manipulative Physical Therapists (IFOMPT)
clinic: Physionnisa Central Clinic, Gulberg III, Lahore

name: Dr. Zara Naveed
title: Physiotherapist & Musculoskeletal Assessment Lead
photo_alt: Dr. Zara Naveed, physiotherapist, conducting an initial patient assessment
bio: Dr. Zara Naveed leads initial consultations at Physionnisa, specializing in thorough musculoskeletal assessment to route each patient to the right specialized care pathway from day one.
education: Doctor of Physical Therapy (DPT), University of Lahore, 2016–2020
specializations: General Musculoskeletal Assessment, Postural Correction, Initial Consultation
clinic: Physionnisa Central Clinic, Gulberg III, Lahore

name: Dr. Komal Sheikh
title: Post-Natal Recovery & Women's Wellness Specialist

bio: Dr. Komal Sheikh guides new mothers through structured post-natal recovery, from Diastasis Recti closure to safe return-to-exercise programming, with an emphasis on realistic, sustainable timelines.

specializations: Post-Natal Recovery, Diastasis Recti, Women's Wellness
memberships: Pakistan Physical Therapy Association (PPTA), International Continence Society (ICS)
clinic: Physionnisa Central Clinic, Gulberg III, Lahore
